summary: On paper the Rams have the edge (The Rams' defense ranks 2nd in broken tackles per touch, 7.7% missed), while Buffalo's best counter is to win up front (Buffalo's defense ranks 2nd in pressure rate, 29% generated). Under center, Matthew Stafford ranks 9th of 15 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: James Cook gains +1.5 rushing yards over expected per carry, 4th of 20, and the Rams' run defense ranks 3rd. The model favors the Rams at 59%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and rushing matchup (0.8 pts).
